# `_gaos` golden fixtures

Every `*.json` file here is a sample request body, response body or stream event of one
`_gaos` operation, built from the upstream pydantic models
(google-genai 2.28.0, <https://github.com/googleapis/python-genai>,

through them (`model_validate` then `model_dump`) so the bytes are what the Python SDK emits.
